title: ME60032: Monitoring And Controlling Of Manufacturing System
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Monitoring 1 Machine Tool Monitoring - Condition Monitoring 2 Manufacturing
Process Monitoring (Welding, machining etc) 3 Online and Offline Quality
Control. 4 Tool condition monitoring, Case studies. 5 Application of soft
computing methods (example: ANN) in tool condition monitoring. Control
Fundamentals of numerical control NC part programming Interpolation PLC based
